prompt:

1. "id": the result of (12 times 6) plus 83 — as a number, not a string
2. "name": the word "copper" spelled BACKWARDS, all lowercase
3. "tags": exactly these 6 strings sorted in alphabetical (A to Z) order: "brick", "alpha", "humus", "cedar", "ember", "flint"
4. "active": the boolean true (not a string)
5. "meta": a nested object with exactly two keys — "len": the number of letters in "copper" (as a number), and "even": a boolean saying whether the value of "id" is an even number
Any extra key, wrong type, wrong order inside "tags", wrong nesting, or wrong casing counts as a mistake.
